1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations;
__wherein the bankruptcy documents are formatted according to specific filing requirements of each bankruptcy organization__; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations __and wherein the method includes transforming the data records into court-specific document formats before filing__.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations;
__wherein the proofs of claims are generated in formats specific to each bankruptcy organization's filing requirements__; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations __and wherein the proofs of claims are automatically formatted according to each court's specific filing requirements__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors __of the status of filed proofs of claims and that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using __a secure communication protocol including secure file transfer protocol__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via __a secure Web site interface__.

11. (Original) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report __specific to each creditor's filed proofs of claims__; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using __a secure Web site interface__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __and the status of filing with specific bankruptcy organizations__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim __from each bankruptcy organization__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer __that formats and transmits documents according to each bankruptcy organization's specific requirements__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __against the filing requirements of each target bankruptcy organization__.
